items.reason: The only registered experimental arm is "Ipilimumab" (2 cycles); chemoradiotherapy follows only after trial treatment ends ("before continuing to standard of care treatment of debulking surgery and chemoradiation"), so it is not given within the experimental arm. D31-C2/C3: partners are agents given with the candidate; chemoradiation that follows trial treatment is not.

Ipilimumab is given alone as neoadjuvant trial treatment, with no other antitumour drug or radiotherapy during it; the record frames it as "the addition of ipilimumab prior to the current standard treatment", which supports reading subsequent chemoradiation as part of the regimen (C1). D31-C3 settles this: standard chemoradiation that follows trial treatment does not make the regimen a combination.

note: Neoadjuvant design: D31-C3 settles regimen as monotherapy and combination_partners as [] (chemoradiation follows trial treatment). Nothing pending for XL.
